integrity: Exact 16-state parity-replica transfer proof and rational polynomial eigenvalue perturbations, separately checked against exhaustive small-system physical quantum evolution and numerical limiting regimes. Self-contained verifier included. No independent external audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: The recent research motivation begins with 2025 transfer-matrix graph-noise phase transitions and 2026 entanglement-horizon analysis. The specific redundant crazy-graph architecture, CZ-edge loss, compatible measurement postselection, and length-independent first-order susceptibility were already publicly studied in arXiv:2402.00937 (2024) and are fully credited. The new statement gives an asymptotic conditional two-terminal crossover, not a finite-length exact threshold or an optimized strategy. For any positive critical scaling variable the postselection probability tends to zero.
title: A quadratic weak-noise entanglement horizon in parity-postselected double-rail graph states
